title: Document Work Assurance v3 — shared vocabulary
description: Single home for the closed shared $defs used by every document-assurance-v3 schema (plan V3-D1..D10). Document-work vocabulary only: no capability, enforcement, activation, authority-grant, receipt, event-chain or consumer/platform vocabulary exists here (N0-A5, N0-A8). Normalized local paths only — no URI/glob algebra (V3-D3).

relPath.description: Normalized repository-relative local path. No leading slash, no drive letter, no '..' segment, no glob (V3-D3: normalized local paths, not URI/glob algebra).

frozenFileRef.description: Exact frozen input: path pinned to one Git revision (plan §6 step 1).

digestRef.description: Content-bound reference: exact bytes pinned by digest (V3-D5: digests are generated bindings, not the product centre).

pointerRef.description: Lightweight state pointer (V3-D8: pointers, never copied evidence).

locator.description: Stable in-file location: heading, block id or line span. Anchor is always required — a bare file path is not a locator.

candidateRef.description: Isolated payload candidate identity (V3-D3: candidate branch/worktree rooted at an exact base).

changeBoundary.description: Acceptance boundary, not hard enforcement (V3-D3): only a candidate whose observed change set conforms may be accepted. An entry names a file or a directory subtree.

checkKind.description: Closed LocalCheckSpec union (plan §5.3). Unknown kind is SPEC_GAP, never dynamic tool discovery.

verificationMode.description: How an obligation is verified: deterministic local check(s) decide it, or semantic review does (plan §5.1, invariant 8). The both-modes value was deleted 2026-08-05 under a recorded user ruling (SIMP-A1): when a check decides only half an obligation, the checker owns half that obligation's truth, so review cannot dispose of the obligation without first judging the checker — which is what pulled every run-local checker into the review subject. The test is whether the machine's answer is the whole answer; if it is not, the mode is review_only and the rationale says why.

assuranceStatus.description: Closed AssuranceWorkState status set mapped 1:1 onto the product flow (plan §6; V3-D8).

auditResult.description: Closed InstructionCoverageAudit result (V3-D7). No repair loop exists for the audit.

auditFindingKind.description: Closed instruction-coverage defect classes observed in real document work (silent omission family).

decisionPhase.description: Closed UserDecision phases (V3-D4). Exactly one typed decision interface exists.
